title: ReliaGate: Reliability Routing for Low-Stakes Wearable Stress Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.15951v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study when a wearable stress system should surface a prediction rather than change it. In low-stakes reflection and summary settings, aggregate accuracy is insufficient because withholding can reduce error while leaving some people with little or no information. We formulate fixed-label reliability routing: after a locked classifier emits a protocol-defined stress/non-stress label, a post-hoc gate surfaces that unchanged label or withholds it as unavailable. ReliaGate assembles established confidence, signal-quality/trust, agreement, train-standardized atypicality, and train-fitted geometry cues into a post-hoc correctness score. We evaluate four wearable datasets using subject-disjoint folds, validation-selected routing, paired held-out-subject intervals, and pooled and per-subject analyses. translated_title: ReliaGate：面向低风险可穿戴压力预测的可靠性路由
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15951v1 公告类型：新  摘要：我们研究可穿戴压力系统何时应显示预测结果而非更改它。在低风险反思和总结场景中，总体准确性不足，因为隐瞒可以减少错误，但会让一些人几乎没有或完全没有信息。我们提出了固定标签可靠性路由：在锁定分类器发出协议定义的压力/非压力标签后，一个事后门控器显示该未更改的标签，或将其作为不可用而隐瞒。ReliaGate将已建立的置信度、信号质量/信任度、一致性、训练标准化非典型性以及训练拟合几何线索整合为一个事后正确性评分。我们使用主题分离折、验证选择路由、配对保留受试者区间以及汇总和逐主题分析评估了四个可穿戴数据集。WESAD点估计支持ReliaGate，UBFC-Phys主要覆盖/风险区间支持ReliaGate，而E4检查结果混杂。ReliaGate提供了可靠性。
tldr: ReliaGate提出了一种事后可靠性路由方法，通过整合多种线索来决定是否显示或隐瞒可穿戴压力预测标签，以提高低风险场景下的预测可靠性。
en_tdlr: ReliaGate introduces a post-hoc reliability routing method that integrates multiple cues to decide whether to surface or withhold wearable stress prediction labels, enhancing prediction reliability in low-stakes scenarios.
